mapper.select: SELECT p.id,s.round_no FROM advance_requestexpense_plan p JOIN finance_resource f ON f.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND f.id=p.id AND f.resource_type=#{argument1} JOIN approval_submission_round s ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.application_id=p.application_id AND s.status='APPROVED' WHERE p.tenant_id=#{argument2} ORDER BY p.id,s.round_no
